cardOverview.overviewText: A premium Elite card from SBI offering milestone shopping vouchers, global lounge access, and lifestyle benefits for affluent users with network benefits of Rupay.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: The transaction is valid for at least 2 tickets per booking per month.|The maximum discount is ₹500 per ticket for 2 tickets only.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.
benefitRows.exclusion: This offer is valid on primary cards only.
